title:
Walk to Broadway
Magnolia House in Glam Germantown
description:
LOCATION,  LOCATION, LOCATION
★ Walk to broadway (1.3 miles)
★ Fully detached house nestled in the heart of Nashville in the safe, vibrant, and bustling Germantown neighborhood, close to the best bars, fine dining, casual restaurants, and music
★Nearby attractions: Broadway, Nashville Farmer's Market, Ryman Auditorium, Honky Tonks, Bicentennial Park,  Ascend Amphitheater, Bridgestone Arena,  Nashville Sounds
★ Kitchen fully equipped 
★ High speed internet
★ 2 free parking spaces
★ Washer & Dryer

The space
Master Bedroom 2nd floor:
1 King bed with en-suite bathroom (tub/ shower combo), Roku TV, & massage chair 

2nd Bedroom 2nd floor: 
2 Queen beds with Roku TV

Laundry Room 2nd floor 
Washer & Dryer 

3rd Bedroom 3rd floor: 
1 King bed with en-suite bathroom (shower only), work space, and Roku TV

Living Room 1st floor: 
Queen-sized pull-out couch, half bath, and Roku TV

Dining Room 1st floor: 
Large dining table (seats 8-10) 

Kitchen 1st floor
Refrigerator, Freezer, Dishwasher, Microwave, Coffee maker(Keurig), Large countertop space, pots & pans, 

Front porch patio 
Multiple chairs

Guest access
You have full access to the property!

The house is keyless entry and the 
door code will be given to you upon arrival.

Other things to note
We have a ring doorbell security camera on the front door and back door. 

We have free parking for 2 cars directly behind the house. Street parking is randomly available on the surrounding streets if you have more than 2 cars. The dedicated parking area behind the house is marked with 2 parking signs.
